name: exercism
description: Tooling for managing my Exercism submissions
author: Jake Worth <jake@jakeworth.com>

scripts.validate: npm run format-check:js && npm run lint:js && npm run test-all:js
scripts.commit: git add -N --ignore-removal . && git add --patch && git commit
scripts.submit: sh -c 'exercise_dir=$(printf "%s" "$2" | tr "_" "-"); git push && exercism submit "$HOME/Exercism/$1/$exercise_dir/$2.js"' --
